title: 第2791章 得线索痛快死法第2790章 杀修士一击毙命
content_zh:
“还想跑？你这种畜生今天必死无疑，最好老实一点，不然有你的苦头吃。”
屠穹像是提死狗一样的将他提起来，然后丢在地上。
此刻的这年轻修士是遍体鳞伤，脊椎骨也崩裂开来了，气息薄弱到了极点，那是半点反抗之力都没有了。
巨大的疼痛席卷全身，让其疼得瑟瑟发抖，整个人的形象已经有了翻天覆地的变化。
乍一看似乎还很可怜。
实际上并非是这样的。
也是说今天他运气不好，遇上了江若尘与屠穹，否则若是遇上了一般的修士，还不成了他的剑下亡魂？
另外通过这修士的一些行为也能分辨出来，他如此的跋扈，平日里稀里糊涂死在他手下的人绝对不少。
在这样的情况下，他哪里会可怜？
只能说是死有余辜。
根本就不值得同情。
“二位，二位道友，我真的知错了，先前是我不对，你们千万不要杀我，我可以带你们回去，将我们钱家所有的底蕴全都交给你们，只求你们能饶我一命。”
在死亡的笼罩之下，这年轻的修士是半点跋扈之色都没有了。
剩下的只有恐惧，害怕跟疯狂的求饶。
这类人可以说是毫无骨气的。
遇弱疯狂的凌辱，想杀就杀。
遇到比自己强的存在就怕了，甚至杀父之仇都不顾，只想着求饶。
这样的人当真令人心生厌恶，非常的瞧不起。
“现在知道求饶了，先前干什么去了？废话少说，我问什么你回答什么。”屠穹将其抓回来后，杀意依旧是不减的。
若非是为了问话，他恐怕早就出手将其斩杀了，根本就不会等到现在。

所以他也不想跟他废话太多，只想问到自己想要的东西。
江若尘依旧是一言不发，在一旁旁观。
而这年轻修士当真已经吓破了肝胆，完全乱掉了分寸。
听到屠穹说要问话，他仿佛看到了求生的希望，那是立马点头如倒蒜，爽快地答应下来。
他觉得自己只要好好地配合，还是可以留下一命的。
于是在接下来的时间里，屠穹问什么，他就回答什么。
甚至还主动地将自己的家世给说了出来。
根据这家伙所交代的东西，江若尘跟屠穹可以知道。
他们这一群人，是来自界中大地的一个家族。
在他们那一带还是有些名气跟实力的。
他是这个家族的少主，而刚才被屠穹一枪给洞穿了身体的人是他的父亲，也是这个家族的家主。
他们这些人大约在三个月前，来到了镇北王国的旧地，目的也是寻找机缘。
想试试开源，亦或者收购一些从源石之中开出来的好东西回去修行。
但在镇北王国旧地游历的时候，无意间遇见了一个年轻的修士。
这年轻的修士勘源手段了得，就是先前江若尘跟屠穹在源城之中，所打听到的那个周
山南。
他们这群人原本是没起什么歹心的。
content_en:
"Still want to run away? A beast like you will definitely die today. You'd better be honest, otherwise you will suffer."
Tu Qiong lifted him up like a dead dog and threw him to the ground.
At this moment, the young monk was covered in bruises, his spine was cracked, his breath was extremely weak, and he had no power to resist at all.
Huge pain swept through his whole body, causing him to tremble in pain, and his whole appearance had undergone earth-shaking changes.
At first glance it seems pitiful.
This is not actually the case.
It also means that he was unlucky to meet Jiang Ruochen and Tu Qiong today. Otherwise, if he had met an ordinary monk, wouldn't he have become the dead soul under his sword?
In addition, it can also be distinguished from some of the monk's behaviors. He is so domineering, and there are definitely a lot of people who die in confusion at his hands.
In such a situation, how could he be pitiful?
It can only be said that he deserves to die.
Not worthy of sympathy at all.
"Two, two fellow Taoists, I really know that I was wrong. I was wrong before. You must not kill me. I can take you back and hand over all the information about our Qian family to you. I only ask that you spare my life."
Under the shroud of death, the young monk lost any trace of his domineering look.
All that's left is fear, fear and frantic begging for mercy.
This kind of people can be said to be spineless.
If you encounter a weak and crazy insult, you can kill if you want.
He becomes afraid when he encounters a being stronger than himself. He even ignores the revenge for killing his father and only thinks about begging for mercy.
Such people are really disgusting and look down upon.
"Now that you know how to beg for mercy, what did you do before? Stop talking nonsense and answer whatever I ask." After Tu Qiong captured him, his killing intent remained unabated.
If it hadn't been for questioning, he would have killed him long ago and wouldn't have waited until now.
So he didn't want to talk too much nonsense to him, he just wanted to ask what he wanted.
Jiang Ruochen remained silent and watched from the sidelines.
But this young monk was really scared to death and completely lost his sense of proportion.
When he heard Tu Qiong wanted to ask questions, he seemed to see hope of survival, so he immediately nodded and agreed readily.
He felt that as long as he cooperated well, he could still survive.
So in the following time, Tu Qiong would answer whatever he asked.
He even took the initiative to tell his family background.
Jiang Ruochen and Tu Qiong can know based on what this guy told him.
This group of people is a family from the land in the world.
They still have some reputation and strength in their area.
He is the young master of this family, and the person whose body was pierced by Tu Qiong's shot just now is his father, who is also the head of this family.
These people came to the old place of Zhenbei Kingdom about three months ago, with the purpose of looking for opportunities.
I want to try open source, or buy some good things from the source stone and go back to practice.
But while traveling in the old areas of the Zhenbei Kingdom, I accidentally met a young monk.
This young monk is very good at investigating sources. He was the Zhou who Jiang Ruochen and Tu Qiong had heard about earlier in Origin City.
Shannan.
This group of people originally had no evil intentions.
